(2) Live proxy read of 45516: 144 forecasters, 0 comments, Closes Sep 28 2026, and a full date-string enumeration yields no opened/published line (only chart labels) - confirms the numerator and kills the hope of dating the open from the page. (3) Live read of twin 45517: 39 forecasters, Closes Sep 5 2028 - corroborates a Sep 5 2026 creation of the pair, and shows the on-page bot aggregate there (0.39 vs ~0.05 arithmetic) is a naive current-rate division, so 5.35 here is not an anchor. (4) Search for a Fall 2026 announcement dating the practice release: empty. (5) fall-aib-2026 tournament page: 404. Settled factually: the inflow is flat ~4.2/day, not decaying - Run 2 dated its 144 read to Sep 18 and divided a 2.03-day gap by 3, so its ~175 numerator is too low; and the late-August open branch conflicts with the ID-clock anchors Run 2 itself cites, so D is 19-23 with only a thin tail past 24. Unsettled and pure judgment: creation ~Sep 5 bounds the open from below but not above, so Sep 6-9 (D=19-22) stays live at ~35%; no evidence breaks that tie and I take the reading I would bet on - modal Sep 5, meaningful short-window weight. That lifts my median above Run 2 (whose numerator and denominator errors both pushed it low) and slightly above Runs 1/3's left-tail shading, and it fattens the upper escape to 6% relative to Run 3's 4%. I carry Run 1/3's reference class (Summer practice post 43339, 156 forecasters over a ~17-23 day window -> 6.8-9.2/day) forward, having re-confirmed the 156 count live.

disagreements.claim: Forecaster inflow is decaying (Run 2: 4.5 -> 3.5 -> 3.0/day) vs flat at ~4.2/day (Runs 1, 3)
disagreements.verdict: Resolved for flat. Same-wall-clock reads give +9/2.00d, +7/2.01d, +9/2.03d; Run 2's 3.0/day came from treating the Sep 15 23:00Z -> Sep 17 23:50Z gap as 3 days. Numerator projects to ~187, not ~175.

disagreements.claim: The question opened around Aug 29, giving D up to 30-33 days (Run 2's back-extrapolation)
disagreements.verdict: Rejected as the main branch. Post 45182 open Aug 19 + ~18-24 IDs/day + the 45518-45577 block open Sep 7 place 45516's creation ~Sep 5, and a post cannot open before creation. Kept at low single-digit weight only for the possibility the ID anchors are wrong.

disagreements.claim: Twin post 45517 closing 'Sep 5, 2028' indicates a Sep 5, 2026 publication of the pair
disagreements.verdict: Confirmed by my own live read (39 forecasters, Closes Sep 5 2028). Strong but indirect: it dates creation, not necessarily open.

disagreements.claim: post 45516's open_time is retrievable from some public surface
disagreements.verdict: Confirmed unavailable - API 403, page carries no opened string under full date enumeration, tournament page 404, no announcement found. Check came back empty, as all three runs reported.

disagreements.claim: The on-page bot aggregate (~5.35) is informative about the denominator
disagreements.verdict: Rejected. It implies D~27-35 days, incompatible with the ID evidence, and the same mechanism prices twin 45517 at 0.39 against ~0.05 arithmetic - it is a naive current-count/elapsed-days artifact, not information.

disagreements.claim: How much weight the shorter-window branch (open Sep 6-9, D=19-22) deserves versus modal Sep 5
disagreements.verdict: Unresolvable on available evidence; creation ~Sep 5 bounds the open only from below. I take ~35% on Sep 6-9, which is what separates my 8.2 median from Run 2's 7.1 and sets the 6% upper escape.

disagreements.claim: Whether a late-entrant surge before the Sep 28 season start lifts the numerator above trend
disagreements.verdict: Plausible (Summer analog's comment mass dated the day before its season start; Fall MiniBench opened Sep 21) but offset by roster saturation near ~173 bots; I let the two cancel and kept straight-line ~187 as the median.

disagreements.claim: A market prices this or a comparable Metaculus-participation metric
disagreements.verdict: None found - no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmaker contract; harness title search also empty. No anchor available.
